quiz.prompt: The last three German reactors shut down in…

goodToKnow: Der Atomausstieg is the nuclear phase-out. The SPD-Green government agreed it in 2000, the Merkel government extended plant lifetimes in 2010, then reversed course after Fukushima in 2011. The last three reactors, Isar 2, Emsland and Neckarwestheim 2, went offline on 15 April 2023. The debate continues, as does der Kohleausstieg (coal phase-out). It has no plural.
